Hamilton, a seven-times world champion, arrived in El Arish on Tuesday, where he was briefed on how aid is prepared and coordinated before it is sent into Gaza, as he toured the Rafah crossing and the Egyptian Red Crescent's aid warehouses.

ai.sum: Lewis Hamilton urged Israel to allow aid trucks into Gaza after visiting the Rafah crossing in Egypt.

items.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles, drones; group denies targeting Mecca
items.summary: DUBAI, Nov 11 (Reuters) - Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi missiles and drones launched towards Riyadh, Mecca and other regions on Wednesday, as hostilities between the Iran-aligned group and the kingdom worsen. The Saudi-led military coalition fighting the Yemeni group said it had intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles headed to the Riyadh region, two drones aimed at Mecca and southern areas and two missiles pointed towards the west.

ai.sum: Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh, Mecca and other regions as Saudi-Houthi hostilities worsen.
